name: SMC Fonts · Malayalam 字体 · Manjari

title.zh: SMC Fonts · Malayalam 字体 · 比较字重与长段落
title.en: SMC Fonts · Malayalam 字体 · Manjari

description.zh: 对照两种文字的笔画，再核字重与同包许可。 Swathanthra Malayalam Computing 发布的 Malayalam 字体集合，提供独立字形预览、字重列表、下载和网页嵌入说明。本次已从原链接取得 Manjari ZIP，含 Regular、Bold、Thin 的 OTF 与完整 OFL，同包字体可依许可条件常规商用；价格、其他字体及网站软件许可仍需分别核对。
description.en: A Malayalam typeface collection from Swathanthra Malayalam Computing, with specimens, weight listings, downloads, and web-embedding instructions. The original Manjari ZIP was obtained and contains Regular, Bold, and Thin OTF files plus the complete OFL. This package permits ordinary commercial font use under its license conditions; prices, other fonts, and website software require separate checks.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by SMC Fonts · Malayalam 字体 (https://smc.org.in/en/fonts/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 对照两种文字的笔画，再核字重与同包许可。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先在目录长段落里比较粗细，再在 Gayathri 字重区看三行小字样，最后打开 Manjari，对照酒红底上的 Malayalam 与拉丁地名。建议先用自己的长段落检查行距和字重。我们已取得含 Regular、Bold、Thin 的 Manjari 原 OTF 包与完整 OFL，常规商用须遵守分发条件；价格、其他字体与网站软件许可仍须另核。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
